It is thought to be an honorable and respected name, providing the bearer with a sense of strength, power, and leadership. This name is often given to children as a source of inspiration, encouraging them to strive for power and influence in their communities andbearing this responsibility with dignity and compassion.
data.spiritual_significance: In the spiritual realm, the name Zulqadr has deep significance, reflecting the belief in the omnipotence and omniscience of God. The name signifies that whatever power and authority an individual possesses ultimately comes from God. It serves as a reminder to humble oneself before God and to use power and influence for His pleasure, rather than for personal gain or selfish ends. The name Zulqadr is a call to greatness, urging individuals to seek closeness to God and to strive for excellence in all aspects of life, while recognizing that true power and authority come from Divine Source.
